postYuridicheskiyIiPomoshnik.lead: A plain guide to how these tools find and cite the law, what to check before you choose one, and where their limits are.

takeaways.title: Key takeaways
items: A legal AI assistant is a language model connected to a search over legal sources. It finds the relevant norms and passages first, then writes its answer from them and cites them.
Legal teams use it for research questions, contract review, questions across their own documents, first drafts and translation.
Citations let you check an answer. They do not make it correct, so a lawyer still reviews the output.
Before choosing a tool, test five things: coverage of Kazakhstan law, sources you can open, data handling and sub-processors, languages, and the review workflow.
